procedure ClinicAppointmentReminders {
  about "Remind each patient about their appointment"
  policy ClinicPolicy
  sheet Visits "Visits" { patient: Text, phone: Phone, starts: DateTime, status: Text, copay: Money, diagnosis: Text private }
  trigger every friday at 08:00

  let all = fetch Visits
  let due = filter all where date_of(starts) == today() + 1 day and status == "booked"
  let msgs = draft each r in due up to 20 sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.patient default 'there'}, a reminder from the clinic: your appointment is tomorrow at {time_of(r.starts)}."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

  policy ClinicPolicy
  sheet Visits "Visits" { patient: Text, phone: Phone, starts: DateTime, status: Text, copay: Money, diagnosis: Text private }

  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

procedure ClinicFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new patient, then follow up once"
  policy ClinicPolicy
  sheet Visits "Visits" { patient: Text, phone: Phone, starts: DateTime, status: Text, copay: Money, diagnosis: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Visits

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.patient}, thanks for choosing the clinic! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Visits
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.patient default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

  send ok

program:
procedure DentalFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new patient, then follow up once"
  policy DentalPolicy
  sheet Patients "Patients" { name: Text, mobile: Phone, next_visit: DateTime, status: Text, balance: Money, medical_history: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Patients

  let first = draft sms to r.mobile: "Hi {r.name default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the office! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Patients
  let now_r = find all where mobile == r.mobile else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.mobile: "Hi {now_r.name}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure DentalFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new patient, then follow up once"
  policy DentalPolicy
  sheet Patients "Patients" { name: Text, mobile: Phone, next_visit: DateTime, status: Text, balance: Money, medical_history: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Patients

  send ok2
}

program:
procedure TutoringWinBack {
  about "Nudge students whose session was long ago"
  policy TutoringPolicy
  sheet Students "Students" { student: Text, parent_email: Email, next_session: DateTime, status: Text, balance: Money, learning_notes: Text private }
  trigger every monday at 10:00

  let all = fetch Students
  let old = filter all where days_between(next_session, today()) >= 42 and status != "cancelled"
  let oldest = sort old by next_session first 15
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 15 email to r.parent_email subject "We miss you": "Hi {r.student}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the center."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

program:
procedure TutoringFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new student, then follow up once"
  policy TutoringPolicy
  sheet Students "Students" { student: Text, parent_email: Email, next_session: DateTime, status: Text, balance: Money, learning_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Students

  let first = draft email to r.parent_email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.student}, thanks for choosing the center! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch Students
  let now_r = find all where parent_email == r.parent_email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.parent_email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.student default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure RestaurantReservationReminders {
  about "Remind each guest about their reservation"

  sheet Bookings "Bookings" { guest: Text, phone: Phone, at: DateTime, status: Text, deposit: Money, allergies: Text private }

  send ok
}

procedure RestaurantWinBack {
  about "Nudge guests whose reservation was long ago"
  policy RestaurantPolicy
  sheet Bookings "Bookings" { guest: Text, phone: Phone, at: DateTime, status: Text, deposit: Money, allergies: Text private }
  trigger every day at 10:00

  let all = fetch Bookings
  let old = filter all where days_between(at, today()) >= 30 and status != "cancelled"
  let oldest = sort old by at first 20
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 20 sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.guest}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the restaurant."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

procedure RestaurantFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new guest, then follow up once"
  policy RestaurantPolicy
  sheet Bookings "Bookings" { guest: Text, phone: Phone, at: DateTime, status: Text, deposit: Money, allergies: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Bookings

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.guest}, thanks for choosing the restaurant! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 1 day else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch Bookings
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "seated" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.guest default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

program:
procedure RetailWinBack {
  about "Nudge customers whose order was long ago"
  policy RetailPolicy
  sheet Orders "Orders" { customer: Text, email: Email, ordered_on: Date, status: Text, total: Money, card_note: Text private }
  trigger every day at 09:00

  let all = fetch Orders
  let old = filter all where days_between(ordered_on, today()) >= 90 and status != "cancelled"
  let oldest = sort old by ordered_on first 20
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 20 email to r.email subject "We miss you": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the shop."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

sop: When a new customer is added to Orders, send a welcome note and mark them "contacted". Wait 5 days. If by then they're marked "shipped" or "cancelled", stop. Otherwise send one check-in message. Show me the messages for approval first. Don't mention the payment notes.

  allow read Orders(customer, email, status, card_note)
  allow write Orders(status)
  allow contact Orders.email
  deny reveal Orders.card_note
  limit sends 50 per day

}

program:
procedure RetailFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy RetailPolicy
  sheet Orders "Orders" { customer: Text, email: Email, ordered_on: Date, status: Text, total: Money, card_note: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Orders

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the shop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 1 day else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 5 days
  let all = fetch Orders
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "shipped" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

  send ok
}

program:
procedure SalonFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new client, then follow up once"
  policy SalonPolicy
  sheet Clients "Clients" { name: Text, phone: Phone, last_visit: Date, status: Text, tab: Money, color_formula: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Clients

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.name default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the salon! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch Clients
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "lapsed" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.name default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure GymRenewalDateReminders {
  about "Remind each member about their renewal date"
  policy GymPolicy
  sheet Members "Members" { name: Text, email: Email, renews_on: Date, status: Text, dues: Money, health_notes: Text private }
  trigger every day at 08:30

  let all = fetch Members
  let due = filter all where renews_on == today() + 2 days and status == "active"
  let msgs = draft each r in due up to 100 email to r.email subject "Your renewal date in two days": "Hi {r.name}, a reminder from the gym: your renewal date is in two days."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

program:
procedure GymFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new member, then follow up once"
  policy GymPolicy
  sheet Members "Members" { name: Text, email: Email, renews_on: Date, status: Text, dues: Money, health_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Members

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.name default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the gym! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 5 days
  let all = fetch Members
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "expired" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.name default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

program:
procedure AutorepairPickupTimeReminders {
  about "Remind each customer about their pickup time"
  policy AutorepairPolicy
  sheet Jobs "Jobs" { owner_name: Text, phone: Phone, promised: DateTime, status: Text, estimate: Money, vin: Text private }
  trigger every friday at 16:00

  let all = fetch Jobs
  let due = filter all where date_of(promised) == today() + 1 day and status == "open"
  let msgs = draft each r in due up to 100 sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.owner_name default 'there'}, a reminder from the shop: your pickup time is tomorrow at {time_of(r.promised)}."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

procedure AutorepairWinBack {
  about "Nudge customers whose pickup time was long ago"
  policy AutorepairPolicy
  sheet Jobs "Jobs" { owner_name: Text, phone: Phone, promised: DateTime, status: Text, estimate: Money, vin: Text private }

  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

program:
procedure AutorepairFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy AutorepairPolicy
  sheet Jobs "Jobs" { owner_name: Text, phone: Phone, promised: DateTime, status: Text, estimate: Money, vin: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Jobs

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.owner_name default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the shop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Jobs
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "ready" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.owner_name default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

program:
procedure BakeryPickupDateReminders {
  about "Remind each customer about their pickup date"
  policy BakeryPolicy
  sheet CakeOrders "CakeOrders" { customer: Text, email: Email, pickup: Date, status: Text, price: Money, address: Text private }
  trigger every monday at 08:00

  let all = fetch CakeOrders
  let due = filter all where pickup == today() + 7 days and status == "new"
  let msgs = draft each r in due up to 30 email to r.email subject "Your pickup date in a week": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, a reminder from the bakery: your pickup date is in a week."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

sop: When a new customer is added to CakeOrders, send a welcome note and mark them "contacted". Wait 3 days. If by then they're marked "confirmed" or "cancelled", stop. Otherwise send one check-in message. I need to OK every message. Never include their home address.

  allow read CakeOrders(customer, email, status, address)
  allow write CakeOrders(status)
  allow contact CakeOrders.email

}

program:
procedure BakeryFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy BakeryPolicy
  sheet CakeOrders "CakeOrders" { customer: Text, email: Email, pickup: Date, status: Text, price: Money, address: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in CakeOrders

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the bakery! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch CakeOrders
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "confirmed" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"

program:
procedure LandscapingQuoteReminders {
  about "Remind each customer about their quote"
  policy LandscapingPolicy
  sheet Quotes "Quotes" { customer: Text, email: Email, sent_on: Date, status: Text, amount: Money, gate_code: Text private }
  trigger every day at 16:00

  let all = fetch Quotes
  let due = filter all where sent_on == today() + 2 days and status == "draft"
  let msgs = draft each r in due up to 50 email to r.email subject "Your quote in two days": "Hi {r.customer}, a reminder from the company: your quote is in two days."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

procedure LandscapingFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy LandscapingPolicy
  sheet Quotes "Quotes" { customer: Text, email: Email, sent_on: Date, status: Text, amount: Money, gate_code: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Quotes

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the company! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 5 days
  let all = fetch Quotes
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "sent" or now_r.status == "declined" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy LandscapingPolicy
  sheet Quotes "Quotes" { customer: Text, email: Email, sent_on: Date, status: Text, amount: Money, gate_code: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Quotes

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the company! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Quotes
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "sent" or now_r.status == "declined" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

sop: When a new customer is added to Quotes, send a welcome note and mark them "contacted". Wait 2 days. If by then they're marked "sent" or "declined", stop. Otherwise send one check-in message. I want to approve each message first. Never include their gate code.
policy:
policy LandscapingPolicy {
  allow read Quotes(customer, email, status, gate_code)
  allow write Quotes(status)
  allow contact Quotes.email
  deny reveal Quotes.gate_code
  limit sends 150 per day
  send only between 07:30 and 19:00
}
sheets: sheet Quotes "Quotes" { customer: Text, email: Email, sent_on: Date, status: Text, amount: Money, gate_code: Text private }

sop: When a new family is added to Families, send a welcome note and mark them "contacted". Wait 7 days. If by then they're marked "waitlist" or "paused", stop. Otherwise send one check-in message. I want to approve each message first. Never include their health notes.
policy:
policy DaycarePolicy {
  allow read Families(parent, email, status)
  allow write Families(status)
  allow contact Families.email
  deny reveal Families.health_notes
  limit sends 200 per day
  send only between 08:00 and 20:00
}
sheets: sheet Families "Families" { parent: Text, email: Email, due_date: Date, status: Text, balance: Money, health_notes: Text private }
program:
procedure DaycareFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new family, then follow up once"
  policy DaycarePolicy
  sheet Families "Families" { parent: Text, email: Email, due_date: Date, status: Text, balance: Money, health_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Families

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.parent default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the daycare! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 1 day else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Families
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "waitlist" or now_r.status == "paused" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.parent}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

}

procedure CleaningWinBack {
  about "Nudge clients whose cleaning was long ago"
  policy CleaningPolicy
  sheet Cleanings "Cleanings" { client: Text, phone: Phone, scheduled: DateTime, status: Text, fee: Money, door_code: Text private }
  trigger every friday at 17:30

  let all = fetch Cleanings
  let old = filter all where days_between(scheduled, today()) >= 42 and status != "cancelled"
  let oldest = sort old by scheduled first 20
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 20 sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.client}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the service."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

sop: When a new client is added to Cleanings, send a welcome note and mark them "contacted". Wait 2 days. If by then they're marked "done" or "cancelled", stop. Otherwise send one check-in message. Show me the messages for approval first. Never include their door code.
policy:
policy CleaningPolicy {
  allow read Cleanings(client, phone, status)
  allow write Cleanings(status)
  allow contact Cleanings.phone
  deny reveal Cleanings.door_code
  limit sends 50 per day
  send only between 09:00 and 21:00
}
sheets: sheet Cleanings "Cleanings" { client: Text, phone: Phone, scheduled: DateTime, status: Text, fee: Money, door_code: Text private }
program:
procedure CleaningFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new client, then follow up once"
  policy CleaningPolicy
  sheet Cleanings "Cleanings" { client: Text, phone: Phone, scheduled: DateTime, status: Text, fee: Money, door_code: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Cleanings

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.client default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the service! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch Cleanings
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.client default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

program:
procedure MusicLessonReminders {
  about "Remind each student about their lesson"
  policy MusicPolicy
  sheet Lessons "Lessons" { student: Text, parent_phone: Phone, lesson_at: DateTime, status: Text, balance: Money, progress_notes: Text private }
  trigger every day at 18:00

  let all = fetch Lessons
  let due = filter all where date_of(lesson_at) == today() + 1 day and status == "scheduled"
  let msgs = draft each r in due up to 20 sms to r.parent_phone: "Hi {r.student default 'there'}, a reminder from the school: your lesson is tomorrow at {time_of(r.lesson_at)}."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

program:
procedure MusicWinBack {
  about "Nudge students whose lesson was long ago"
  policy MusicPolicy
  sheet Lessons "Lessons" { student: Text, parent_phone: Phone, lesson_at: DateTime, status: Text, balance: Money, progress_notes: Text private }
  trigger every day at 08:30

  let all = fetch Lessons
  let old = filter all where days_between(lesson_at, today()) >= 30 and status != "cancelled"
  let oldest = sort old by lesson_at first 10
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 10 sms to r.parent_phone: "Hi {r.student}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the school."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 12 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

sop: When a new refund request is added, check it. If the purchase was more than 14 days ago, tell me and stop. If it's over $100, I'll handle it myself. Refunds of $15 or less can go through without me; anything bigger needs my OK. After refunding, mark it refunded and let the student know (I approve that message too).
policy:
policy MusicRefundPolicy {
  allow read RefundRequests(request_id, student, parent_phone, amount, purchased)
  allow write RefundRequests(status)
  allow contact RefundRequests.parent_phone
  limit refund $100 per action
  limit refund $600 per day
  refund without approval up to $15
  limit sends 50 per day

program:
procedure MusicFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new student, then follow up once"
  policy MusicPolicy
  sheet Lessons "Lessons" { student: Text, parent_phone: Phone, lesson_at: DateTime, status: Text, balance: Money, progress_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Lessons

  let first = draft sms to r.parent_phone: "Hi {r.student default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the school! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 3 days
  let all = fetch Lessons
  let now_r = find all where parent_phone == r.parent_phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.parent_phone: "Hi {now_r.student default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

program:
procedure BikeshopRepairReminders {
  about "Remind each customer about their repair"
  policy BikeshopPolicy
  sheet Repairs "Repairs" { customer: Text, phone: Phone, ready_on: Date, status: Text, estimate: Money, lock_code: Text private }
  trigger every thursday at 16:00

  let all = fetch Repairs
  let due = filter all where ready_on == today() + 1 day and status == "waiting"
  let msgs = draft each r in due up to 100 sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.customer}, a reminder from the shop: your repair is tomorrow."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

procedure BikeshopFollowUpAfterWait {

  policy BikeshopPolicy
  sheet Repairs "Repairs" { customer: Text, phone: Phone, ready_on: Date, status: Text, estimate: Money, lock_code: Text private }

program:
procedure BookstoreHoldReminders {
  about "Remind each customer about their hold"
  policy BookstorePolicy
  sheet Holds "Holds" { customer: Text, email: Email, held_until: Date, status: Text, prepaid: Money, phone_note: Text private }
  trigger every wednesday at 08:30

  let all = fetch Holds
  let due = filter all where held_until == today() + 2 days and status == "waiting"
  let msgs = draft each r in due up to 50 email to r.email subject "Your hold in two days": "Hi {r.customer}, a reminder from the store: your hold is in two days."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 1 day else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

  policy BookstorePolicy
  sheet Holds "Holds" { customer: Text, email: Email, held_until: Date, status: Text, prepaid: Money, phone_note: Text private }

  send ok
}

sop: When a new customer is added to Holds, send a welcome note and mark them "contacted". Wait 5 days. If by then they're marked "ready" or "expired", stop. Otherwise send one check-in message. Show me the messages for approval first. Never include their private notes.
policy:
policy BookstorePolicy {
  allow read Holds(customer, email, status)
  allow write Holds(status)
  allow contact Holds.email
  deny reveal Holds.phone_note
  limit sends 100 per day
  send only between 07:30 and 19:00
}
sheets: sheet Holds "Holds" { customer: Text, email: Email, held_until: Date, status: Text, prepaid: Money, phone_note: Text private }
program:
procedure BookstoreFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy BookstorePolicy
  sheet Holds "Holds" { customer: Text, email: Email, held_until: Date, status: Text, prepaid: Money, phone_note: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Holds

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer}, thanks for choosing the store! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 5 days
  let all = fetch Holds
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "ready" or now_r.status == "expired" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

program:
procedure YogaFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new student, then follow up once"
  policy YogaPolicy
  sheet Passes "Passes" { name: Text, email: Email, expires_on: Date, status: Text, credit: Money, injury_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Passes

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.name default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the studio! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 1 day else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 7 days
  let all = fetch Passes
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "expired" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.name}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure PetgroomerFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new pet owner, then follow up once"
  policy PetgroomerPolicy
  sheet Grooms "Grooms" { owner: Text, phone: Phone, appointment: DateTime, status: Text, price: Money, behavior_notes: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Grooms

  let first = draft sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.owner default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the salon! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 1 day else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 2 days
  let all = fetch Grooms
  let now_r = find all where phone == r.phone else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "done" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft sms to now_r.phone: "Hi {now_r.owner default 'there'}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 1 day else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}

procedure PrintshopWinBack {
  about "Nudge customers whose print job was long ago"
  policy PrintshopPolicy
  sheet Jobs "Jobs" { customer: Text, email: Email, due: Date, status: Text, quote: Money, file_link: Text private }
  trigger every friday at 08:00

  let all = fetch Jobs
  let old = filter all where days_between(due, today()) >= 30 and status != "cancelled"
  let oldest = sort old by due first 20
  let msgs = draft each r in oldest up to 20 email to r.email subject "We miss you": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, it's been a while! We'd love to see you again at the shop."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}

sop: When a new customer is added to Jobs, send a welcome note and mark them "contacted". Wait 5 days. If by then they're marked "printed" or "cancelled", stop. Otherwise send one check-in message. I need to OK every message. Never include their file link.
policy:
policy PrintshopPolicy {
  allow read Jobs(customer, email, status, file_link)
  allow write Jobs(status)
  allow contact Jobs.email
  deny reveal Jobs.file_link
  limit sends 100 per day
  send only between 07:30 and 19:00
}
sheets: sheet Jobs "Jobs" { customer: Text, email: Email, due: Date, status: Text, quote: Money, file_link: Text private }
program:
procedure PrintshopFollowUpAfterWait {
  about "Contact a new customer, then follow up once"
  policy PrintshopPolicy
  sheet Jobs "Jobs" { customer: Text, email: Email, due: Date, status: Text, quote: Money, file_link: Text private }
  trigger when new row r in Jobs

  let first = draft email to r.email subject "Welcome": "Hi {r.customer default 'there'}, thanks for choosing the shop! Reply with any questions."
  let ok1 = request approval of first from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "first message not approved"
  send ok1
  update r set status = "contacted"
  wait 5 days
  let all = fetch Jobs
  let now_r = find all where email == r.email else stop "row was removed"
  if now_r.status == "printed" or now_r.status == "cancelled" {
    stop "already handled"
  }
  let second = draft email to now_r.email subject "Checking in": "Hi {now_r.customer}, just checking in. Is there anything we can help with?"
  let ok2 = request approval of second from owner timeout 2 hours else stop "follow-up not approved"
  send ok2
}
